comment: Verbatim copies of the custody-manifest contract from Digital-Frontier-LDA/regalia-kms. The ceremony validates with the SAME code CI and the daemon use rather than a re-implementation, because a manifest the ceremony writes and regalia-kms then refuses is the failure this whole tool exists to prevent. Do not edit these files here: re-copy them from upstream, update the digests and the commit below, and let test_ceremony_manifest.py prove the copy. tools/custody_manifest.py reads config/backend-capabilities.json relative to its own location, which is why the upstream tools/ and config/ layout is kept.
